description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial dispute between S. A. Kamalasena, Kuda Oya, Buttala and other Part "Lanka Sugar" Company (Pvt.) Ltd. Colombo 04 and Lanka Sugar Company (Pvt.) Ltd. Pelawatta Buttala
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically the revocation and issuance of orders for arbitration in an industrial dispute. It involves statutory instruments, legal procedures for dispute resolution, and references to specific legislative enactments and amendments, making it clearly fall under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
